limits: Static consistency does not imply complete source qualification or a completed gate on a new worktree.
A future integrated source must build/bind its own ELF and run exact source guards; the old C7 binary cannot borrow the new History bytes or commit identity.
C7 History local scope remains compile/list only; no 4105-block workload execution or qualification is asserted.
reason: The generated Rust file registers include_bytes paths; it stores neither a fixed digest nor literal old History bytes. Changed contents at the same registered path are incorporated at compilation. Unchanged path set and generator leave the generated registration text unchanged.
